requirements.text: Bachelor’s degree statistics, analytics, bioinformatics, data science or equivalent field.
2-5 years of experience in data science, analytics, statistical programming, data engineering, or related disciplines.
Complete or Full / Career proficiency in R, Python or other statistical languages and packages.
Intermediate-level knowledge of statistical and data mining techniques.
Intermediate proficiency with visualization tools such as Spotfire, PyDash/Plotly, or equivalent platforms.
Experience applying machine learning, artificial intelligence, or generative AI technologies to business problems.
Experience developing automated reporting, data products, or end-to-end analytical solutions.
Familiarity with clinical data standards (e.g., CDISC SDTM/ADaM) and clinical development processes preferred.
Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver results in a fast-paced environment.
Strong collaboration and communication skills and experience working in cross-functional teams.

Apply AI to transform statistical programming: use agentic coding and generative AI to generate, validate, and document code and outputs, contribute to migrating legacy SAS programs to R, and measure resulting efficiency gains.
